prompt:
[T-CODEX-2D] Task file: docs/game-design/visual/06-tasks/prompts/IC-36.codex.md (Claude writes it from this text; [[B-...]] blocks are pasted verbatim from docs/game-design/visual/07-prompt-templates.md section 0.3).
Task IC-36 — Shape sketches for four new glyphs: end turn, card to discard, game log, pointer cursor. Priority P1. Depends on —.
Purpose: give the v3 vector engine exact shape numbers for four glyphs the game HUD needs: end the turn now; this card will go to the discard pile; open the log of game events; the cursor over anything clickable.
[[B-PACKAGE]]
Set: hud-icons-vr44 (your folder is art/imagegen/hud-icons-vr44-codex/).
Read: art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/STYLE-v3.md sections 1-4, 8, 11 (rule 9 brush/ink part is cancelled); art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/_tools/draw_icons.py; docs/game-design/visual/02-visual-design.md sections 4.4, 5 and 11.4; art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/sheets/sheet-sizes.png; art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/sheets/sheet-context-panel.png; docs/game-design/visual/06-tasks/icons.csv rows IC-36, IC-46, IC-48, IC-55, IC-59. Record sha256 of every input in source-hashes-before.json.
1. Concepts. With image generation make 2 concepts (A, B) per glyph, 8 images in total. Image prompt for each:
   "Original small HUD glyph concept. Square image, one centered glyph only, outer bounds within 15-85% of the canvas, uniform solid background #061623. [[B-STYLE]] Family: <family>. Meaning: <meaning>. Glyph: <glyph>. Must stay clear at 24, 32 and 48 px. Colours: <colours>. No lettering, no numbers. [[B-FORBID]]"
   Values:
   - end-turn. Family: round action pip (dark disc with a cream ring). Meaning: end the turn now. Colours: body card.navy #061623, ring card.cream #F9EBDB, glyph card.glyph #FAF8F2, keyline mark.keyline #111317. Glyph A: a straight right-pointing arrow that stops at a vertical bar. Glyph B: a bold right chevron that stops at a vertical bar.
   - card-drop. Family: square state badge (dark body, cream edge). Meaning: this card will go to the discard pile. Colours: as end-turn. Glyph A: a short down arrow landing on a pile of two flat slanted plates. Glyph B: one card outline tilted 12 degrees sliding down behind a short horizontal pile edge.
   - log. Family: bare white glyph on a dark button. Meaning: open the log of game events. Colours: glyph #FAF8F2, keyline #111317. Glyph A: three short horizontal lines, each with a small square bullet on its left. Glyph B: a small rolled scroll with two text lines.
   - pointer. Family: mouse cursor, 32 px. Meaning: this element is clickable. Colours: body #FAF8F2, keyline #111317 (2 px at 32 px), ring #F9EBDB. Glyph A: a flat pointing hand, index finger up and to the left, the fingertip is the hot spot. Glyph B: the standard arrow cursor with a small cream ring around its tip (the selection ring of the board).
2. Vector. In your _tools module add each glyph to a local CANDIDATES dict using the v3 grid: 32 u canvas, keyline 1 u (cursor 2 u), edge 1.25 u, stroke W 2.25 u, every detail >= 1 u snapped to pixels; detail removed (not thinned) at detail <= 1; compound shapes by fill + CLEAR, no clip. Pip: keyline r 14-15 u, cream ring r 12.75-14 u, body inside. State badge: square 30 u in a 32 u field, corner radius 1.5 u.
3. Export from vector: 1024 master and 16, 21, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96 px; the cursor also exactly 32 and 64 px, with its hot spot pixel (x, y) at both sizes written to verification.json. No motion layers are needed.
4. Sheets: concept A / concept B / vector, at 1024 and at 24, 32, 48 px (x4 nearest), colour and gray; each glyph on card.navy #061623, on card.cream #F9EBDB and on a neutral board grey #808080. One extra gray sheet at 18, 24 and 32 px: end-turn next to state-boost and the four action pips; card-drop next to state-pending-place; log next to resource-card and a plain three-bar menu sign; pointer next to a plain arrow cursor.
5. Write in README the exact numbers of the recommended form (radii, half-spans, stroke widths in u) so Claude can copy them into draw_icons.py one-to-one.
Deliverable: art/imagegen/hud-icons-vr44-codex/ as in 07 section 1.1; vector/{1024,16,21,24,32,48,64,96}/{end-turn,card-drop,log,pointer}.png and -gray.png; comparison/*.png; verification.json; manifest-sha256.json; source-hashes-before.json; README.md in Russian.
Readability: clear at 24, 32 and 48 px; in gray each glyph differs from the neighbours of step 4; every detail >= 1 px at 24 px.
Do: one stroke weight for all four glyphs, the same as the v3 set; end-turn stays in the pip family; card-drop uses the card-stack language of the deck counter.
Do not: an arrow into a tray or box (reads as download); three plain bars for the log (that is the menu sign); an hourglass for end turn (it means waiting for the server); red anywhere; the words Unmatched or Digital Edition in image prompts; any game screenshot or card scan as input; any edit of art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/.
Acceptance: verification.json has source_unchanged true, outside_folder [], palette with 0 opaque pixels outside dE76 <= 3 of the listed colours, gray pairs distinct (luma difference >= 20 or a different shape); A, B and the vector exist for every glyph; the cursor hot spot is recorded; README gives the numbers of the recommended form and the reason.
